subject: Able to show data from database, but not able to plot its data.

messages.author: f9c5f1187ca3c5b6
messages.subject: Able to show data from database, but not able to plot its data.
parts:
I am able to display the data from a database, but not able to plot it. Why is this so? when I try to plot the cars2 data, it can be displayed. But when I try to plot using plotData(), which contains the database data, with dygraph, the plot does not show out. But if I manually load those individual lines below

 data_DT <- as.POSIXct(data$readingdate,format="%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S")
    data_TS <- xts(data$measurevalue01,order.by=data_DT)

    theGraph <- dygraph(data_TS, main = "Tuas Water Consumption") %>%
      dySeries("V1", label = "Daily Water Consumption (m^3)") %>%
      dyLegend(show = "always", hideOnMouseOut = FALSE)

    print(theGraph)

and I am able to get the plot from RStudio's plot. But I need that plot to be at Shiny.

Code as below:
